Only Astro pulls it in, at build time; Atlas is static files on GitHub Pages and runs no shared cache, so the leak can't happen here. Drop this entry once a fixed version ships (the ratchet fails on stale entries).

Only the MCP SDK's Express helpers pull it in; the Worker (app/mcp) imports the web-standard transport, so Express and body-parser are never bundled or run. The fix (2.4.0, 2026-10-22) is younger than min-release-age; drop this entry once npm can resolve it (from 2026-10-29).
